name: Lim JeongHyun
source:
Beumi moved to the same town when he was 5 years old and they has been friends all the time. JeongHyun sometimes try to be an older brother. He seems to be experiencing late puberty recently. The next person Beumi has been close to recently is Song Tae-jin, a basketball player.
[ Translator: [url=https://www.facebook.com/sophroniamoon888/]Sophronia Moon[/url] ]
